title: How we measure a signal: four targets, one rule
author: TrustForex
excerpt: Every signal is issued with TP1 through TP4 and fixed R:R values, so every result is judged against targets that were known from the start.

title: Reading the Win Rate chart
author: TrustForex
excerpt: What a Win Rate bar contains, what a No Signals period means, and how to compare the four targets across the same weeks.

title: Scalp Levels: what the first 15 minutes tell you
author: TrustForex
excerpt: A Scalp Level is measured from its first touch for a fixed 15-minute window, so every Level is judged on equal terms.

title: Cashback: what your share actually means
author: TrustForex
excerpt: The Cashback percentages are your share of the eligible rebate from a partner broker. They are not a share of your deposit, volume, profit or loss.

title: Two referral links, one lasting connection
author: TrustForex
excerpt: The website link tells the full story first; the Bot link opens Telegram directly. Both record the connection at the first Bot Start, and it does not expire.

title: Why we recorded before we published
author: Amir Dankoob
excerpt: Signal presentation was standardised first, and outcomes were recorded under one framework from early 2026, before the product was ready to launch.

title: No Signals is not zero
author: TrustForex
excerpt: A period without signals stays in the sequence as No Signals. It is neither removed from the record nor counted as a failure.
